goal_giao_shielding.gap: The corrected native ORCA GIAO shielding input still needs to be run on the fixed prepared HCN geometry, and a follow-up analysis step must parse every nuclear total tensor and isotropic value before this goal can be claimed.

proposal.reason: The prior revise_plan was rejected because goal_giao_shielding combined a gap with a step_key. I am correcting it to a gap-only Goal target, since the planned ORCA run is preparatory and the Goal still requires a follow-up analysis of all nuclear shielding tensors. The new step binds the already-written corrected input hcn_nmr.inp, which contains explicit RKS PBE0/def2-TZVP NMR NoAutoStart and the required %maxcore, %scf, and %elprop blocks, together with the existing prepared.xyz geometry.
